title: A multi-modal transformer for cell type-agnostic regulatory predictions
summary: The study describes EpiBERT, a multimodal Transformer pretrained on DNA sequence/chromatin accessibility, then evaluated on held-out cell types for regulatory predictions and variant effects. This is a specific cross-cell-type regulatory-prediction result; computational validation only.
